# Tesseract WASM Runtime & VFS

## Component Description

The low-level execution environment for OCR. It manages the Emscripten-based WebAssembly lifecycle, including memory allocation and a Virtual File System (VFS) used to load language training data (.traineddata) and temporary image buffers.
